master:
Use case: precise-object-edit / game asset. REDRAW ONE SIMPLE CARD FRAME from input1. Input1 is the existing game's silver-gray frame; keep its basic familiar shape and low level of detail. Inputs2,3,4 are painting-style references ONLY, never copy their characters, text, clothes or UI.
Deliver exactly ONE reusable frame-only PNG with TRUE ALPHA transparency outside AND in its large empty rectangular interior. No background, no card art, no paper or rules panel, no letters or numbers, no cost badge. The game will draw all contents separately.
IMPORTANT GEOMETRY: vertical canvas 1024 by 1536. Rectangular INNER OPENING x=96 to928, y=144 to1392 (832 wide,1248 tall). MAIN FRAME outer bounds x=32 to992, y=80 to1456. All four main rails are 64 pixels thick, equal visual weight, small softly cut corners. Top and bottom rail as thick as side rails. Leave all remaining canvas transparent. This is the master geometry for a whole series; do not use the entire canvas edge as the outer border. Do not narrow the opening or make top/bottom thick.
Version: INITIAL / plain silver-graphite gray, no rose, no crest, no bottom jewel. A restrained muted cool gray frame with a few broad directional opaque brush planes, hand-drawn slightly imperfect edges and a few decisive highlights. Keep the old frame's modest complexity and overall silhouette, painted rather than polished.
No squashing/stretching of a previous frame, no glossy chrome or luxury carved metal, no tiny facets/scratches, no grain filter, no neon. Broad simple gray shapes from the existing frame, lower refinement. No unrelated decorations.

variants.label: 古朴
variants.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit input1 MASTER GAME CARD FRAME to produce ONE alternate color-and-crest version, retaining EXACTLY the same frame geometry and brushwork level. It must remain a reusable transparent overlay, not a whole card.
CRITICAL: Same 1024x1536 canvas as input1. Preserve the exact inner transparent aperture, exact core outer silhouette, exact x/y positions, and exact width of each of the four main rails. The owner explicitly rejected frames that became thinner by squashing. DO NOT rescale, widen, narrow or compress the frame or flowers. Only recolor the existing rails and add the specified small crest/insets. The crest may project OUTSIDE the main rail; do not make rail thicker to accommodate it. Equal border thickness across all rarities/classes is essential.
TRUE ALPHA TRANSPARENCY outside frame AND entire interior hole; remove any faint background/shadow haze. No card illustration, paper/rules panel, text, numerals, energy socket, cost badge, page or background.
Preserve input1's restrained simple hand-painted anime block-brush level, opaque broad strokes, grouped muted gray planes, decisive edges, few selective highlights. No increased refinement, no tiny scratches, no luxury filigree, no shiny 3D, no noisy facets, no neon. Keep the tiny decorations simple and naturally proportioned.
VERSION: 古朴. Unadorned muted gray iron, a little darker and less shiny than master. No rose and no added ornament.
